description: Whether one ETF delivers what its category promises, from the ETFIQ Promise Index: a badge (Delivered, Partly or Missed) with the number behind it, its window and the sentence the fund page prints, plus its category's promise, the test and its thresholds, and the category's Promise Index. A fund the test cannot be run on says so with the reason.

ticker.description: One fund's ticker, such as JEPI.

name: etf_promise
